name: VitaIPTV
description: Native IPTV player for PS Vita / PS TV – M3U, Xtream, HLS, HTTPS
long_description: A native IPTV player for the PlayStation Vita and PS TV (HENkaku / Ensō). Watch live TV, films and series and listen to radio from your own M3U playlists or Xtream accounts, decoded by the Vita's hardware H.264 decoder.
